points: Built HELPIT, a mental health social network, as my hackathon project.
Learned rapid prototyping, teamwork and the full product cycle under time pressure.
Invited for my work on HELPIT to a youth event held at the Marriott Bonvoy hotel (3 days, 2 nights).
Presented how technology can be built with social purpose to young leaders.
Developed a SaaS MVP for personal coaches covering frontend, backend and database.
Project was paused by the client before completion.
